choose-konjac-powder-gum.claim: ALL KONJAC lists konjac powder, refined konjac powder and konjac gum as enquiry categories.
Ingredient grade selection is discussed against intended application and requested specification.
Technology enquiries may address texture, thickening, gel formation, water holding or stability.

konjac-equipment-project-brief.claim: Enquiries may cover individual machines or production-line integration.
The equipment brief calls for product, output, process stages, space, utilities and existing equipment constraints.
Installation, commissioning and training scope is confirmed in the project quotation.
Formulation development can be discussed with process and equipment requirements.

plan-konjac-dried-chip-drying-line.claim: Drying-line projects connect material preparation, conveying, drying equipment, air handling and process integration.
Project briefs ask for material, output, process, factory and utility conditions.
Equipment images and reference configurations are illustrative; final specifications require project confirmation.
